owner_directive: Owner hand-test of ADR-034 multi-provider found five defects: (1) claude prints 'Transcript saving is off - inherited CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION marker'; (2) safety-critical: Manual Approve launches claude in auto mode and codex in YOLO mode; (3) SciStudio data-protection/tool-use HOOKS do not take effect for codex and Qoder (skills DO work); (4) codex/Qoder bottom input box intermittently unrendered until keyboard down-arrow; (5) core: kimi-code AI Block fails to launch (PTY exit 1) and codex receives a truncated prompt cut at 'manifest at:'. Owner decisions: finding 2 must pass an explicit manual permission flag per provider as a descriptor field symmetric with bypass_argv; finding 5a is codex-only; finding 3 is re-scoped to hooks, not skills.
